product_overview: A modern web-based resume builder that lets users create, import, edit, preview and export professional resumes quickly using curated templates and a live WYSIWYG editor. Targeted at students and job seekers who need fast, high-quality resume output.
core_goals: Enable rapid creation and visual editing of resumes with live preview that matches exported output
Provide a curated template library and simple template selection workflow
Allow users to import existing resumes (.pdf, .docx, .txt) to populate builder fields
Provide one-click export to PDF and Word preserving on-screen formatting
Keep the editor accessible without authentication and persist work locally (auto-save)

features.name: Interactive Resume Builder
features.description: A live editor where users can edit content, reorder sections, change theme accents, and see immediate visual updates in a preview canvas.
user_flows: Navigate to /builder -> Edit the resume title -> Select a resume template -> Change accent color -> Reorder sections -> Fill personal information -> Add and fill experience entries -> Add and fill education entries -> Add skills and contact information -> See live preview update to reflect edits
Navigate to /builder -> Fill in required fields incompletely or with invalid values -> See validation errors that prevent saving or finalizing the resume -> Correct inputs to clear validation errors

features.name: Template Library
features.description: A gallery of pre-designed resume templates with thumbnails so users can choose a layout and style appropriate to their use case.
user_flows: Navigate to /templates -> Browse template thumbnails -> Select a template to use -> Navigate to /builder -> See the selected template applied to the current resume
Navigate to /templates -> Attempt to preview a template -> Template preview fails to load -> See an error message or fallback thumbnail suggesting reload

features.name: Resume Import
features.description: Upload an existing resume (.pdf, .docx, .txt) to auto-populate builder fields via server-side parsing.
user_flows: Navigate to /builder -> Choose to import a resume -> Select a .pdf, .docx, or .txt file -> Wait for parsing to complete -> See builder fields populated with parsed content
Navigate to /builder -> Choose to import a resume -> Select an unsupported file type -> See a file type validation error and instructions for supported formats

Navigate to /builder -> Choose to import a resume -> Select a supported file -> Upload request is sent to http://localhost:8000/api/resume/upload -> Receive an upload or parsing error due to backend unreachable -> See an error message explaining the backend connection issue

features.name: Resume Export
features.description: Generate and download the resume as a PDF or Word document that preserves on-screen formatting.
user_flows: Navigate to /builder -> Request PDF export -> POST request is sent to http://localhost:8000/api/export/pdf -> Receive generated PDF and download begins -> Open downloaded PDF to confirm formatting matches the preview

Navigate to /builder -> Request PDF export -> POST request to http://localhost:8000/api/export/pdf fails (backend unreachable or CORS/error response) -> See an export error message and no file is downloaded
